name: manual_0c7355
claim: A bash script that runs set -u must length-guard EVERY array expansion, because macOS stock bash 3.2 treats an empty-array expansion of the form dollar-brace-arr-at-brace as an unbound-variable error rather than an empty expansion. Canonical idiom: [[ ${#arr[@]} -gt 0 ]] && cmd+=(arr-elements). This is the THIRD recurrence of the same defect class (after commit_clean_test.sh verify_args and a profiling wrapper), so treat it as a systemic pattern: when fixing one instance, scan every set -u script in the repo with a single regex for unguarded += expansions and fix all confirmed instances, then prove the fix against a stubbed dependency that leaves the array empty.

decisions.notes: Gate 4 / K1 dispatch: the tracked ClinePass wrapper (run_clinepass_deepseek_flash.sh) aborted with auto_args[@]: unbound variable at line 92 whenever the installed Cline CLI advertised neither flag of a drift pair, so codex could not dispatch a Cline worker through the tracked wrapper and had to route through a throwaway compatibility copy. Reproduced end-to-end with a stub CLI (exit 1 before, exit 0 after) and confirmed the positive path still passed the flags. A repo-wide scan of 128 set -u scripts found exactly two risky sites; the sibling exec_cline.sh was already guarded, which is how the correct idiom was identified. Fixed in orama-system commit 88209503.
